brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH: attempted addDrawer at half-s north face (socket s16) together with spike at junction 0,-1|0,0|1,-1 (socket s17) covering the same corner was refused with code SPIKE_CLASH - 'a spike stands at a corner of this cell the drawer (north half) would fill. Take the spike off first.' No alternative socket offers co-location; alternatives list empty. A drawer on the opposite cut face (half-n south) can coexist with a spike at a different corner (tested: half-n + pieces at 0,-1 and 1,-1 allowed both parts), but that is a different corner, not the required same-corner touching arrangement. check_build on current 2-piece base shows meshClash clear but no such combined placement exists.

finish.summary: Requirement is unmet by design: the configurator explicitly forbids a spike and a drawer occupying the same corner of the same cell (SPIKE_CLASH). Demo attempt reproduced the refusal; only placements at different corners are allowed, which does not satisfy 'very same corner'.
